minutes.headline: Board approved the school-project debt exclusion ballot question and special town meeting warrant, plus annual business licenses.
minutes.summary: The board voted on a short-term bond anticipation note for the school feasibility study, the ballot question and the special town meeting warrant for the new Middle High School debt exclusion, and a long list of annual business licenses. A resident asked about total interest cost and urged clearer wording that the ballot question is a debt exclusion, not an override. The board also accepted a historical commission resignation and heard committee reports.

public_comment.topic: Asked about total interest cost of the school bond over 20 and 30 years, staffing impact, timing of state payments, how the term was chosen, and asked that the ballot question be explained as a debt exclusion rather than an override.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved the ballot question for the new Middle High School debt exclusion as printed.
The board approved the special town meeting warrant for the school project as printed.
The board approved the bond anticipation note for the school feasibility study, as awarded by the treasurer to the lowest bidder.
The board approved annual business licenses, including common victualler, amusement device and class one, two and three licenses.
The board agreed the chair may sign the MSBA reimbursement rate certification and project documents.

why_it_matters: The ballot question and warrant set up the vote residents will be asked to take on a debt exclusion, which raises property tax bills for the life of the school bond.
A resident asked that the ballot wording say plainly it is a debt exclusion, not an override, and the interest cost over the bond term was raised as a figure voters may want to see.
